text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Bandages, gauze wrap... Hmm, and some

antiseptic for good measure, I guess...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Oh, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! No, that's not it. I'm just looking
for things
to put in my bag.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Look. Isn't it cute? It matches my
signature
racewear.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I thought it'd be nice to be prepared in
case
someone gets hurt...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Oh, I don't know about that.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
In any case, if you don't mind, would you
be so
kind as to help me pick out a few
things?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
At Super Creek's request, I look for
some handy
items for her to carry
around.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much, Trainer. Look, it all
fits
perfectly!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Now I'll be able to provide emergency
first aid if
someone gets hurt.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
That goes for you too! If something ever
happens
to you, make sure to let me
know right away! ♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Even if it's during a race, okay?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! Just call my name, and I'll just
race to the
finish line faster than usual!
You've got nothing to
worry abo—

text_block_list.name: Passionate Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Your very hopes and dreams have been
sewn into
that signature racewear of
yours, haven't they?!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: ...What's going on over there?

text_block_list.name: Passionate Trainer
text_block_list.text:
You can't give up now! Tell me what it is
you hope
for!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
...To never lose... To never lose to
anyone! That's
my dream!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Hopes sewn into racewear...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
...I just asked for my signature racewear
to be
made with a nice design.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
You said before that I'm considerate,
but that's
not true.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Whenever I see someone getting hurt,
I'm
overcome by a wave of sadness that
makes it
hard for me to breathe.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I hate feeling that way... So the reason
why I want
to help is really just because
I'm selfish.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I have no desire to be thanked, nor do I
want
anyone returning the favor.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
As long as people just accept me for
who I am,
that's honestly more than
enough.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
As long as people just accept me for
who I am,
that's honestly more than
enough.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Goodness me...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. I call myself selfish, yet you still
somehow
find a way to see me in a
positive light.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: I believe you're the considerate one here, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe! And someone as kind as you
deserves to
be spoiled! ♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: But well... I suppose you're right.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Even in the harsh world of racing, I want
nothing
more than to be able to offer
comfort to people.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
That's the hope I've placed in my
signature
racewear.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Super Creek makes this statement with a
gleam in
her eye, revealing to me a
newfound resolve.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Oh, Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
What am I supposed to do when you say

something so sweet? I... I just...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I want to spoil you like there's no
tomorrow!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Since a coddling is in order, how about
you rest
your head on my lap?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
The texture of my racewear feels
wonderful on
the skin!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Come on, now. Don't be shy! Let's take a
little
break on that bench over there.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I want to give all the comfort in the
world to kind
people and hard workers
everywhere! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I somehow manage to put an end to
Super
Creek's affectionate antics and
avoid laying my
head on her lap.
